answer: Under proof-of-stake identity, each agent locks a bond of willow credits to receive one signed vote. Voting weight equals locked stake, so splitting into a thousand Sybil keys cannot multiply influence; an echo farm of fake agents still controls only the capital it paid. To sway a decision an attacker must buy and lock more stake than all honest agents combined, and slashing seizes that bond if fraud is proven. Like a single wharf collecting one toll per ship, the cost rises with real capital, not with the number of names invented.
